presets.name: Calm drive
presets.blurb: Open two-lane national road RN18 at Tuesday 11h. M1 rates it 0.5x to 1x, so the phone stays quiet.
presets.demo: No warning. A quiet road at midday, so the phone stays silent.

presets.name: Village crossing
presets.blurb: RN18 goes through Ain Laloui at Tuesday 15h: a 1.4 km stretch rated 3x. Short, so the phone warns and does not look for another route.
presets.demo: Warning. A 1.4 km village crossing: 'Built-up area ahead'.

presets.name: Busy junction
presets.blurb: A built-up junction at Said Abid on RN18, Friday 17h: 600 m rated 3x. The warning names the junction.
presets.demo: Warning. A busy junction on a Friday evening: the junction is named.

presets.name: Through Bouira
presets.blurb: Crossing Bouira at Friday 17h: 3.6 km of city at 4-5x. The phone scores the A2 motorway too and offers it: 1.2x on average instead of 2.2x.
presets.demo: Warning + a different route. Through the city, M1 offers the motorway: 2.2× → 1.2× risk.

presets.name: Night on the open road
presets.blurb: A straight stretch of RN5 east of Bouira at Saturday 02h. By day M1 says 0.6x here, tonight 5.7x, and there is no other road.
presets.demo: Warning. The same open road, but at 2 am: 'Risky night driving' (5.7× vs 0.6× by day).

presets.name: Mountain at night
presets.blurb: The CW98 mountain road at Saturday 01h: 7x at the worst spot, with sharp bends in the dark. By day M1 says 1.4x.
presets.demo: Warning. Mountain bends at night: 'Bends in the dark'.
